written.headline: AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase
written.summary: Indian AI infrastructure firm AM Intelligence is looking to raise as much as $3 billion to finance its previously announced order of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin systems. The financing could include bonds, bank loans and a $300 million advance payment from offtakers.

written.headline: Nvidia in talks to back Nscale with credit guarantees for Anthropic data center
written.summary: Nvidia is discussing providing Nscale with billions of dollars in credit guarantees to fund a 460 MW AI data center in West Virginia. Anthropic plans to use the facility and has a separate $45 billion deal to rent computing power from Nscale.

written.headline: Chinese AI firms DeepSeek and Moonshot AI used OpenAI's GPT‑6 Astra for model distillation
written.summary: DeepSeek's V4.1‑Flash‑1017 and Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro were trained using outputs from OpenAI's GPT‑6 Astra through a distillation process, according to a report citing insiders.
